While the `source` uses a tag-based URL that could in theory point to mutable content, this is not relevant for `--printsrcinfo`, as no download or verification occurs during this step. The safety gate is narrowly focused on execution during sourcing, which poses no risk here.

Therefore, sourcing this PKGBUILD for `makepkg --printsrcinfo` is safe.
</details>

The package depends only on standard system libraries and Rust build tools. While the maintainer is a GitHub user (common in AUR), the source is from their own public repository with no indication of malicious redirection or third-party code execution.
</details>
